final: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS baseline_avg FROM status_avgs), qualifying AS (SELECT status, avg_conf FROM status_avgs WHERE avg_conf > (SELECT baseline_avg FROM baseline)), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS mean_qualifying FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.avg_conf, q.avg_conf - b.baseline_avg AS avg_minus_baseline, q.avg_conf / qm.mean_qualifying AS avg_divided_by_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying AS q CROSS JOIN baseline AS b CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS qm WHERE b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL AND qm.mean_qualifying IS NOT NULL
